title: Console BFF: integrate Suggestions read APIs w/ feature-flag gating + tenant allowlist
author: Chloe Martin
description: Adds Console backend (BFF) integration for the Optimize Suggestions read-only beta. This wires the Console BFF to the suggestions-service endpoints (list + detail), with explicit feature-flag gating (suggestions_beta) and per-tenant allowlist checks to ensure the beta is invisible to non-enabled workspaces. The intent is to keep the UI implementation (ENG-2404) simple by consolidating auth/gating and downstream error handling in the BFF layer. Behavior: (1) If suggestions_beta is OFF for the workspace, return 404 from the BFF routes (do not leak feature existence). (2) If flag is ON but tenant is not allowlisted, return 404. (3) If flag + allowlist pass, proxy to suggestions-service with tenant-scoped auth; map upstream errors into Console-friendly error codes (insufficient_telemetry, stale_baseline, upstream_unavailable) without exposing internal service details. (4) Adds lightweight request logging + correlation IDs for troubleshooting; audit logging is intentionally out-of-scope here (tracked separately). Endpoints added (Console internal): GET /console/api/optimize/suggestions?route_id=&model=&region=&cursor=&limit= and GET /console/api/optimize/suggestions/:id. Notes: this PR does not change UI; it only enables the UI to consume stable BFF routes. Testing: unit tests for gating + allowlist, contract tests for upstream response mapping, and a basic happy-path integration test with mocked suggestions-service.
commits: bff(optimize): add suggestions routes + upstream client
bff(flags): gate suggestions behind suggestions_beta + allowlist
bff(errors): normalize suggestions-service failure modes for console
test(bff): add unit tests for gating + 404 behavior
chore(logging): add request_id propagation + safe debug fields
review_conversation: Jada Williams: Please avoid returning 403 for flag/allowlist failures; we should not expose that this feature exists yet. 404 is fine, but make sure the error body is indistinguishable from a normal missing route response.

Chloe Martin (author): Updated handler to return 404 with the standard Console error envelope and removed the prior reason string. Added tests asserting body does not include 'suggestions' when gated.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: Tenant scoping: confirm we never accept tenant/workspace from query params and always derive it from the Console session context. Also ensure we do not forward any customer identifiers into logs.

Chloe Martin (author): Confirmed workspace_id comes from requestContext only; removed workspace_id from debug logs and replaced with hashed workspace fingerprint for correlation. Added a regression test that query workspace_id is ignored.

Felix Schneider: Error mapping: upstream 429/503 should become a generic 'upstream_unavailable' for now; we can surface more detail later in the UI. Also, please document the mapping table in README so front-end has stable semantics.
Chloe Martin (author): Done. Added mapping table and examples in apps/console-bff/README.md under 'Optimize Suggestions beta'.
Dylan Brooks: Looks good. One more nit: cursor/limit validation should cap limit to prevent accidental heavy list pulls in large tenants.
Chloe Martin (author): Added max limit=200 and default=50; request >200 is clamped. Added test coverage.
release_notes: Internal only: Console BFF now exposes gated Suggestions read APIs for the Optimize Suggestions beta (list + detail).
